title: How Green Is Your Manifesto? Scoring Environmental Positions in the 2024 EU Elections with an LLM Panel
abstract: arXiv:2611.02033v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Locating political parties on environmental and climate policy is central to the study of party competition, yet the established instruments, expert surveys and the hand coding of manifestos, are costly, periodic, and slow to extend to new documents. We ask whether a panel of large language models can serve as a cheaper and reproducible alternative. Treating each manifesto as a set of sentences, three models from independent providers score every sentence on two dimensions, environmental protection and climate change, separating a party's position on an issue from the salience it gives it, and the judgments are averaged to the manifesto level. Agreement across the models is retained as a built-in reliability signal. translated_title: 你的宣言有多“绿色”？——利用大语言模型小组为2024年欧盟选举中的环境立场评分
translated_abstract: 在环境与气候政策上对政党进行定位是政党竞争研究的核心，然而现有的测量工具——专家调查和对宣言的人工编码——成本高昂、具有周期性，且难以快速扩展到新文档。我们探究一组大语言模型能否作为更廉价、可复现的替代方案。我们将每份宣言视为句子的集合，来自三个独立提供商的模型在两个维度——环境保护和气候变化——上对每个句子进行评分，从而将政党在某一议题上的立场与其赋予该议题的显著性区分开来，并将各模型的评判结果平均到宣言层面。模型间的一致性被保留下来作为内置的可靠性信号。我们将该模型小组应用于2024年欧洲议会选举中的41份宣言，涵盖奥地利、法国、德国、意大利、西班牙以及欧洲各政党家族，并以2024年教堂山专家调查为基准进行验证。
tldr: 该论文提出用三个来自不同提供商的大语言模型组成评审小组，对2024年欧洲议会选举中41份政党宣言逐句在环境保护与气候变化两个维度上自动评分，从而提供一种比专家调查更廉价、可复现的政党环境立场测量方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an LLM panel of three models from independent providers that scores sentences in 41 party manifestos from the 2024 European Parliament elections on environmental protection and climate change dimensions, offering a cheaper and reproducible alternative to expert surveys for measuring party environmental positions.
